meta.title: Woodruff County — the money trail
meta.note: This is the county's 2026 budget (Ordinance 2025-15) as filed with the state. Fund amounts come from the ordinance's table of approved appropriations by fund; the parts under each fund are added up from the line-item budget. The line-item budget's General Fund adds to $50,000 less than the ordinance table, so that gap is shown, not hidden.

nodes.name: County General Fund
nodes.note: The ordinance table (p. 2) appropriates $2,488,412.58 to this fund. The line-item budget prints a fund total of $2,438,412.58 (p. 13), and its departments add to that: $50,000.00 less than the ordinance table.
